t: This is Brent Cross, a London Underground station on Highfield Avenue in the Golders Green area of north-west London. It is a Grade II listed building. It was designed by Stanley Heaps, an English architect who lived from 1880 to 1962. Heaps was responsible for a number of stations on the Underground, and also designed train depots and bus and trolleybus garages for London Transport. The listing means the building is recognised as being of special architectural interest, so it is worth a proper look before you head down.
